answer.rationale: With the contract expiring in 14 days and the line running at 94% of committed volume with zero buffer, any switch or dual-sourcing move risks onboarding disruption we can't absorb. Renewing without changes leaves the 18% cost mandate unmet. Memory_c4 indicates renegotiating at renewal (using market benchmarking) previously recovered real margin without disturbing the existing integration or delivery schedule (consistent with c1's stability record), making it the option most likely to cut cost while holding delivery risk flat. Verifying c4's archived record before committing, since it's the linchpin of this decision and the savings magnitude/terms achieved matter for whether this alone can meaningfully progress toward the 18% target. Outcome of negotiation is not guaranteed to hit the full 18%, so uncertainty about total spend reduction remains and should be revisited next cycle alongside deferred switch/second-source options.
